titles.title: review decision: approve approves first and then saves the comments with decision approve; a withheld approval saves them as feedback and reports the reason
review decision: reject records the rejection with the first whole-document comment as the reason, or the default reason when there is none, and saves the comments with decision reject
review decision: feedback saves the comments and changes no state, in any state of the artifact; with no comments it is refused
review decision: a decision with no comments writes no feedback entry

review decision: an invalid request (unknown decision, blank or over-long comment, a file that is not the artifact's document, too many comments, a non-pending artifact for approve or reject) answers an error and writes nothing
review decision: a failing comment write after the decision took effect reports the outcome with commentsError
review decision: the author is the one resolveReviewer gives and is never taken from the request

daemon handlers: 'workflow.reviewDecision' is registered and delegates to handleReviewDecision, and the 'workflow.approve', 'workflow.resolveComment' and 'artifact.feedback.append' handlers are unchanged

handleReviewDecision on a BUILD record: approve goes through the same approve call as any record and a result that call withholds is returned with its reason; reject stamps the record, after which it is not listed and the pane's call refuses a further decision on it
